title: Canonical circuit family
statement: A circuit family is canonical if, for every natural number $n$, its circuit at parameter $n$ is canonical: each gate’s argument indices are strictly increasing, and the output index plus one equals the circuit’s size, defined as $n$ plus the number of gates.
